when: is_prohibited_category is True
title: Inadmissible work type
explanation: Work type '{category}' is prohibited under the scheme guidelines
provenance: Evidence: MPLADS Guidelines 2023, Annexure-II prohibited works list

when: siblings_same_day_same_agency >= 3 and sanctioned_amount_paise < tender_threshold_paise and (siblings_same_day_same_agency * sanctioned_amount_paise) >= tender_threshold_paise
title: Tender limit evasion
explanation: {siblings_same_day_same_agency} works sanctioned to the same agency on one day, each below the {tender_threshold_paise|inr} tender limit
provenance: Evidence: eSAKSHI sanction register, same-agency same-date clustering

when: tender_conducted is False and sanctioned_amount_paise >= tender_threshold_paise
title: No tender on record
explanation: {sanctioned_amount_paise|inr} sanctioned above the {tender_threshold_paise|inr} threshold with no tender recorded

when: uc_pending_days is not None and uc_pending_days > 90
title: Utilisation certificate overdue
explanation: Utilisation certificate pending {uc_pending_days|days}; next instalment is blocked until it is filed

refs.guideline: MPLADS Guidelines 2023, Para 4.3 (UC before next instalment)

when: work_ceiling_paise is not None and sanctioned_amount_paise > work_ceiling_paise
title: Above per-work ceiling
explanation: {sanctioned_amount_paise|inr} exceeds the {work_ceiling_paise|inr} ceiling for a single work
provenance: Evidence: eSAKSHI sanction record vs scheme ceiling

when: creates_durable_asset is False
title: No durable asset created
explanation: Work does not result in a durable asset, which the scheme requires
provenance: Evidence: work classification vs scheme asset definition

when: days_recommend_to_sanction is not None and days_recommend_to_sanction < 0
title: Sanctioned before recommendation
explanation: Sanction predates the MP recommendation by {days_recommend_to_sanction_abs|days}

when: agency_blacklisted is True
title: Blacklisted implementing agency
explanation: Implementing agency '{implementing_agency}' is on the blacklist register
provenance: Evidence: agency registration and debarment register

when: duplicate_sanction_code is not None
title: Duplicate sanction
explanation: Substantially identical work already sanctioned as {duplicate_sanction_code}

when: land_is_public is False
title: Work on non-public land
explanation: Asset is being created on land not recorded as public property

when: status == 'completed' and has_completion_certificate is False
title: Completion certificate missing
explanation: Work is marked complete with no completion certificate on record

when: private_benefit_flag is True
title: Private or commercial benefit
explanation: Work appears to benefit a private or commercial entity rather than the public

when: cost_ratio is not None and cost_ratio >= 1.5
title: Cost anomaly
explanation: Reported {sanctioned_amount_paise|inr} is {cost_ratio|x} the {benchmark_total_paise|inr} benchmark
note: Calibration: a 3x overstatement saturates the anomaly budget.

when: cost_zscore is not None and cost_zscore >= 3.0
title: Unit cost outlier
explanation: Unit cost is {cost_zscore|x} standard deviations above the district mean for '{category}' works
provenance: Evidence: statistical comparison against same-category works in this state

when: iforest_flag is True
title: Multivariate cost anomaly
explanation: Cost, quantity and amount together fall outside the normal pattern for this work type
provenance: Evidence: unsupervised anomaly detector (Isolation Forest) over sanctioned works

when: unit_rate_ratio is not None and unit_rate_ratio >= 2.0
title: Unit rate above schedule
explanation: Unit rate is {unit_rate_ratio|x} the scheduled rate in {benchmark_source}

when: cost_revision_ratio is not None and cost_revision_ratio >= 1.3
title: Cost revised upward
explanation: Sanctioned cost is {cost_revision_ratio|x} the original estimate
provenance: Evidence: eSAKSHI estimate vs sanction comparison

when: sanctioned_qty is not None and sanctioned_qty <= 0
title: Implausible quantity
explanation: Sanctioned quantity is recorded as {sanctioned_qty}, which cannot be verified

when: nearest_similar_work_m is not None and nearest_similar_work_m < 10
title: Location anomaly
explanation: Another similar work sanctioned {nearest_similar_work_m|m} away
note: 20 points, less 1 for every 4 m of separation from the nearest similar work.

when: max_photo_similarity is not None and max_photo_similarity >= 0.90
title: Image similarity
explanation: {max_photo_similarity|pct} match with another work's evidence photo
note: Stepped: >=95% is a near-certain re-upload, 90-95% is suggestive.

when: min_gps_trust is not None and min_gps_trust < 40
title: Location data unreliable
explanation: Evidence photo location scores {min_gps_trust}/100 for trustworthiness
provenance: Evidence: EXIF, mock-location and travel-speed checks

when: citizen_mismatch_reports is not None and citizen_mismatch_reports >= 3
title: Citizen reports contradict record
explanation: {citizen_mismatch_reports} independent citizen reports disagree with the official record

when: max_photo_offset_m is not None and max_photo_offset_m > 200
title: Evidence photo taken off site
explanation: An evidence photo was captured {max_photo_offset_m|m} from the sanctioned location
provenance: Evidence: EXIF GPS vs sanctioned coordinates

when: days_sanction_to_completion is not None and days_sanction_to_completion < 7
title: Implausible completion time
explanation: Work recorded as completed {days_sanction_to_completion|days} after sanction

when: completion_before_sanction is True
title: Completion predates sanction
explanation: Completion date falls before the sanction date

when: photo_shared_across_agencies is True
title: Evidence shared across agencies
explanation: The same evidence photo appears under a different implementing agency

when: measurement_shortfall_pct is not None and measurement_shortfall_pct >= 10
points: 15 if measurement_shortfall_pct >= 40 else (10 if measurement_shortfall_pct >= 25 else 5)
title: Measurement mismatch
explanation: Observed {field_measured_value} {qty_unit} vs {sanctioned_qty} {qty_unit} sanctioned
note: Material shortfall bands: >=40% severe, >=25% significant, >=10% minor.

when: field_observed_status == 'not_started' and physical_progress_pct > 20
title: No work found on site
explanation: Field officer found no work started, against {physical_progress_pct}% progress reported

when: field_observed_status == 'different_work'
title: Different work at location
explanation: Field officer found a different work at the sanctioned location

when: days_overdue is not None and days_overdue > 0
title: Timeline anomaly
explanation: Work is {days_overdue|days} past its expected completion date
note: 1 point per 8 days overdue, capped at the inefficiency budget.

when: days_since_progress_update is not None and days_since_progress_update > 90
title: Progress stalled
explanation: No progress update recorded for {days_since_progress_update|days}

when: utilisation_pct is not None and utilisation_pct < 50 and days_since_sanction > 365
title: Low fund utilisation
explanation: Only {utilisation_pct|pct} of sanctioned funds utilised after a year

when: satellite_status == 'inconclusive'
title: Satellite cannot resolve this work
explanation: Imagery resolution is insufficient for a work of this footprint; field verification is required instead
note: PROCEDURAL, ZERO POINTS. An unusable sensor must never manufacture suspicion. This reason raises field-verification priority without moving the score.
